source_summary: Chinese blue-green landscape with waterside architecture, layered rock paths, tree groves, distant bridge, pavilions, and speckled water surfaces. Calligraphy/seal and paper margins are excluded.

motifs.name: distant_mist_bridge
motifs.description: Faint arched bridge emerging from pale mist at the far left edge, with light grey ink contour and two soft vertical supports fading into the water haze.

motifs.name: speckled_lotus_water
motifs.description: Open water surface along the left and lower portions, carrying scattered dark leaf-like dots, small blue-green washes, and pale blank water space around the shore.
must_preserve: irregular dotted lotus or floating-leaf marks

motifs.name: riverside_stilt_house
motifs.description: Waterside rectangular house on a raised stone embankment, with tiled sloping roof, tan walls, red railing/window accents, and blocky stacked foundation stones descending into the water.
must_preserve: grey tiled roof grid and ridge lines
slight perspective of the roof plane

motifs.name: left_bank_pines_and_bamboo
motifs.description: Tree cluster behind and above the waterside house, including a pale vertical bamboo-like trunk, soft green pine canopies, and fine dark foliage strokes along the bank.
must_preserve: layered shrub texture behind the roof

motifs.name: hilltop_pavilion_tower
motifs.description: Elevated two-story pavilion or tower near the upper center, partly hidden by trees, with orange-brown walls, grey-green tiled roof, upturned eaves, and a small dark base under foliage.

motifs.name: central_dense_tree_grove
motifs.description: Large central grove of dark blue-green trees with branching trunks, layered rounded foliage masses, and dense stippled leaf texture standing between the buildings and rocks.
must_preserve: fine twig linework visible through leaves

motifs.name: right_thatched_pavilion
motifs.description: Small pavilion or cottage on the right hillside, with pale walls, angular dark roof lines, triangular gable detail, and surrounding light trees and shrubs against ochre rock.
must_preserve: thin black roof and wall outlines

motifs.name: lower_right_wall_bridge_and_pines
motifs.description: Lower-right garden wall or bridge segment with pale railings and posts, set among dark pines, rounded rocks, and a curving bank/path leading into the foreground.
must_preserve: pale railing posts and panel divisions
ink contour lines along the bank

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
